output_dir.description: every file goes here; pretrain.yaml's dataset_dir points here

fasta.description: swissprot, trembl, uniref50, uniref90, uniref100, a URL, or a local .fasta/.fasta.gz

weight.description: Share of training sequences (not tokens) drawn from this source. Weights must sum to 1; with one source it is 1 or left out.

prepared.description: A folder another data.yaml built, used as it is. Set fasta or prepared, not both. A prepared source takes no data_params overrides and no cluster_subsampling.

members.description: uniref90, uniref100, a FASTA URL/path, or null (= this source's fasta). Required.

clustering.description: auto: UniProt clusters for UniRef data, MMseqs2 otherwise; or uniprot, mmseqs2

identity.description: mmseqs2 only: min sequence identity within a cluster

cluster_subsampling.description: Turns on cluster subsampling for this source: each epoch trains on one random member of every cluster. The block being present turns it on; delete or comment it out to turn it off. max_seqs and val_ratio then count clusters, not sequences.

sources.description: One entry per source, keyed by a name you pick (letters, digits and _). Each names a fasta to build from or a prepared folder. Any data_params field set on a source overrides the default for that source. Only one source is supported for now.

samples_per_shard.description: raised automatically when a cluster pool needs it
